svg.title: Homepage Topology · Portrait
svg.desc: Five portrait forms share a 640 by 800 viewport. Center the visible composition vertically when both wings are expanded or one wing is folded. When running tasks exhaust the vertical budget, compact the source wing first and center the task stack vertically. The hub, rails and task column retain their horizontal positions across forms.
